topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I was fetching water from the well, my mind tied to the drip of the next rain, when I stumbled upon a piece of parchment in my wife’s chest. It was not like any list of seeds to plant or debts to settle. No, this was a list of dreams, like the stars above, so far and yet, they light the night. There, in her careful hand, were scrawls of places to see, songs to learn, and tales to tell. It made the earth beneath my feet feel anew, like the first turn of the soil in spring. It made me think, perhaps, there’s more to the world than the rut of the plow. I’ll speak to her about it, gentle like a morning breeze, and see where this path might lead.
